text:
leah: Heads up I'm switching to a 1099 internal contractor role effective 2026-08-01. There's a payroll vendor migration the week before. I have a 401(k) loan balance ~ $2,450. What are my options to avoid that being treated as a distribution?

sam: Usually you can either repay directly to the plan administrator or have the final paycheck withhold the balance. After termination, payroll can't keep withholding. Migrations can complicate timing.

hrbot: PlanAdmin excerpt: "Outstanding loan balances at termination become taxable distributions unless repaid or otherwise cured within the plan's allowable period. Direct repayments (ACH/wire) to PlanAdmin are processed daily; payroll withholding must be set before final payroll cutoff."

leah: Important dates: vendor migration 2026-07-25 -> 2026-07-29. Last payroll cutoff is 2026-07-24 EOD for pay run on 2026-07-25. So I probably need to finalize any payroll deductions by 7/24.

carlos: Correct. If you want final paycheck withholding, email payroll@redwood with subject "LOAN WITHHOLD AUTH - leah" and include LoanID, amount, and signature by 2026-07-23 to be safe. If you prefer ACH to PlanAdmin, send payment confirmation and we'll mark the loan paid.

leah: If I do ACH now, how do I get the account details?

payroll: Send ACH questions to benefits@planadmin.com or use the PlanAdmin portal. If you need a wire, PlanAdmin provides wire instructions on the portal. Include your LoanID (e.g., 660221). We'll reconcile once PlanAdmin posts the payment.

sam: Note on rollover: loans can't be rolled into an IRA. If unpaid, the unpaid amount is treated as a distribution and will reduce rollover-eligible balance.

leah: OK. One more Q: I also contributed to HSA this month but that contribution hasn't hit the plan yet. Can that be corrected after termination?

carlos: Payroll can run a supplemental correction if the contribution was intended pre-termination, but it must be requested before the payroll migration cutoff. After migration, corrections are still possible but slower — might require manual off-cycle. Request by 7/24.

hrbot: Automated note: LoanID 660221; balance $2,450; orig date 2025-12-10. PlanAdmin cure period: 60 days from loan default.

leah: Action plan: I'll either ACH the $2,450 to PlanAdmin today or submit the LOAN WITHHOLD AUTH by 7/23. I'll also ask PlanAdmin to confirm ACH posting times around migration. Thanks.

payroll: If you send ACH, please cc payroll@redwood so we can reconcile quickly. If you go with final paycheck withholding, we need the signed auth as a PDF reply.

sam: If anyone from legal needs to flag contractor conversion + benefits impacts, ping legal. But this is standard.

leah: Done  sent ACH request and pinged PlanAdmin. Will update thread once they confirm. :thumbsup:
